summary: Full backend + frontend testing of WorkMate HU v2 (JWT auth, user_id scoping, invoices, reports, settings, onboarding). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/duplicate/wrong-pwd/me), 401 protection for /customers /jobs /quotes /invoices /worklogs /documents /dashboard /reports /company, CRITICAL user data isolation (userA cannot GET/PUT/DELETE userB's records — all return 404; new user dashboard shows 0 customers), full Quote→Job→Invoice pipeline (quote-to-job sets quote status='elfogadva', job-to-invoice creates invoice with quote items + sets job='szamlazva', idempotent), invoice PDF (application/pdf, %PDF header, >1KB), reports payload structure (12 months). Frontend Playwright: /belepes loads, demo login (demo@workmate.hu/workmate123) works, dashboard shows all 6 stat cards (stat-customers/jobs/quotes/invoices/monthly-revenue/yearly-revenue), all 10 sidebar nav items visible & clickable (dashboard, customers, jobs, quotes, invoices, reports, worklog, documents, company, settings), sidebar-collapse works (264→84px), Reports page shows report-yearly/paid/unpaid/acceptance + revenue-chart + top-customers-card + report-summary-card, Settings page shows correct user data (Demo Vállalkozó / demo@workmate.hu / WorkMate Demo Kft.), settings-theme-btn toggles html.dark class, Invoice modal opens, inv-item-desc/qty/price fields fillable, invoice-totals correctly computes Nettó 2000 / ÁFA 540 / Bruttó 2540, save-invoice-btn persists, quote-to-job-{id} and job-to-invoice-{id} flow work end-to-end, invoice PDF endpoint returns 200 application/pdf via Bearer token, sidebar-logout redirects to /belepes, registration creates new isolated user with onboarding-banner visible, mobile (390x844) sidebar-open hamburger works.

integration_issues.issue: Fresh user shows 6 seeded customers instead of 3. Cause: Dashboard.jsx useEffect calls POST /api/seed, and React StrictMode invokes the effect twice in dev; the two concurrent seed requests both see count_documents==0 and both run insert_many (race condition on the guard). Isolation itself is intact (fresh user does NOT see demo user's data), only seed duplication.

action_items: Optional: make /api/seed race-safe (e.g. atomic check-and-insert or use MongoDB unique index / seeded flag on user) OR guard the frontend useEffect with a ref so StrictMode double-invocation does not fire two seed requests. Current impact: only cosmetic (fresh account gets 6/8/4 instead of 3/4/2 demo rows).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/seed lacks atomic guard against concurrent invocation → double-seeding on React StrictMode. Consider adding a `seeded: true` field on the user document set on first successful seed, or use insert_one with unique index on (user_id, name) to become idempotent.
server.py build_pdf font path glob runs at first request; already cached in module-global _FONTS.
current_user reads JWT_SECRET from env — good; but JWT tokens have 7-day expiry with no refresh mechanism (acceptable for MVP).
Data isolation is thoroughly correct: every CRUD query filters by user_id and returns 404 on other-user IDs. Verified by parametrized cross-user test.
Register endpoint returns 400 on duplicate email (not 409); acceptable but 409 is more semantic.
server.py DEMO_PASSWORD is only used at startup to seed demo user; production should rotate or remove.
test_credentials: demo@workmate.hu / workmate123 (auto-seeded on backend startup). Tests also create fresh users via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Demo user was seeded on backend startup. Multiple TEST_-prefixed users, customers, jobs, quotes, invoices created during tests (some cleaned up, some remain — isolated per test user, safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All 24 tests green. Auth is Bearer JWT via Authorization header AND fallback to cookie. Fresh users trigger POST /api/seed on first dashboard load; StrictMode double-fires causes 6/8/4 rows instead of 3/4/2 — cosmetic only. Data isolation across users is verified and correct.
